details: Customers of Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, withdrew $3.64 billion (2.1% of its assets) following a $6.3 billion security breach last week. The exchange has reassured investors that withdrawals are stabilizing, and deposits remain "substantial." Binance stated it has covered 95% of the stolen assets. The incident, linked to North Korea, led to initial drops in Bitcoin and Ethereum prices and impacted stablecoin market capitalizations and spot Bitcoin ETF outflows.
title: Binance Outflows Stabilize After Record $6.3 Billion Hack

details: The US midterm elections on November 3, 2026, will determine control of Congress, potentially impacting the future of crypto regulations, including the CLARITY Act. This week also brings key US economic data, such as manufacturing, jobs, and consumer sentiment reports, which could influence interest rate expectations and overall risk appetite. Uncertainty surrounding these events is expected to lead to market volatility.
title: US Midterm Elections and Economic Data to Drive Market Volatility

details: The Bank of Korea has launched a survey of 18 banks and 13 brokerages to assess their exposure to cryptocurrency-related risks. The central bank is examining how these financial institutions would be affected by scenarios such as a major exchange hack, a market crash, or significant losses at other financial entities. This initiative, which began before the recent Binance hack, highlights growing regulatory scrutiny of crypto risks within the traditional financial system.
title: Bank of Korea Probes Financial Firms on Crypto Risk Exposure

details: The UK government plans to introduce legislation in Finance Bill 2026–27 to treat certain stablecoins similarly to money for tax purposes. This proposal, expected to take effect in April 2027 if approved, aims to simplify tax accounting for frequent payments and settlements involving eligible stablecoins. These stablecoins would typically need to be fiat-backed, widely available, and designed for payment use to qualify.
title: UK Proposes Money-Like Tax Treatment for Eligible Stablecoins
